usageNote: 字面是跑步冲线，但也能比喻完成任何超难任务！说出来超有成就感的那种～

examples.en: She crossed the finish line in first place after months of training.
examples.zh: 经过几个月的训练，她第一个冲过了终点线。

examples.en: We finally crossed the finish line and launched the app after two years of hard work.
examples.zh: 经过两年的努力，我们终于完成了目标，成功发布了这款应用。
